firm_data.firm_description: Radulescu LLP is a patent litigation firm specializing in cases requiring a deep understanding of technology and legal issues. They focus on high-stakes, multi-patent, multi-jurisdiction disputes and defending strong patent portfolios.
notable_facts: David C. Radulescu, Ph.D., has litigated more patent cases than any other lawyer in the country in the field of semiconductor light emitting devices (LEDs).

email.subject: AI for Radulescu LLP, built for patent litigation firms
email.body:
Hi David,

Your track record litigating more LED semiconductor patent cases than any other lawyer in the country speaks to the depth you bring to high-stakes, multi-patent disputes. That expertise deserves tools that match your precision.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on discovery, case analysis, and deal work.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
